Revise a published ETR when the P50 moves by more than the margin the procedure sets. [1] A move at or below that margin is logged but not released. [2] Re-run the model at each operational period change. [3] A revised ETR needs the same approvals as a first release. [4] Those approvers are the Incident Commander and the Duty Manager, who sign on F-DOM-121. The source is DOM 14.206.

Sources:
[1] DOM 14.206 Rev K, 6.0 PROCEDURE; 7.0 RECORDS; 8.0 REFERENCES; ATTACHMENT A - Release Decision Table, pp. 2-4: "6.4.2 Revise a published ETR when the P50 moves by more than 12 h."
[2] DOM 14.206 Rev K, 6.0 PROCEDURE; 7.0 RECORDS; 8.0 REFERENCES; ATTACHMENT A - Release Decision Table, pp. 2-4: "6.4.3 A move of 12 h or less is logged but not released."
[3] DOM 14.206 Rev K, 6.0 PROCEDURE; 7.0 RECORDS; 8.0 REFERENCES; ATTACHMENT A - Release Decision Table, pp. 2-4: "6.4.1 Re-run the model at each operational period change."
[4] DOM 14.206 Rev K, 6.0 PROCEDURE; 7.0 RECORDS; 8.0 REFERENCES; ATTACHMENT A - Release Decision Table, pp. 2-4: "6.4.4 Revised ETRs need the same approvals as in 6.2.4."
